output_profile: Same exact frozen question plus plain numeric-ID-only suffix, 16 token cap, no tools or constrained decoding
output_instruction_suffix: Return only the numeric option ID (1, 2, 3, 4 or 5), without explanation.
reasoning: Explicitly off for switchable models; ordinary and nonthinking checkpoints have no reasoning parameter
provider_policy: Exact provider/quantization tag, standard service, no fallback, require_parameters true

concurrency.barrier: All 16 model-question cases settle before next two-question wave

order: First 25 IDs are the outcome-independent pilot sample; all remaining IDs SHA256 ordered; model launch order seed 2026101508
timing: New HTTPS connection per attempt; monotonic connect through complete response body; excludes local queue/preparation; retry waits recorded separately
primary_score: First attempt per planned case. Errors, refusals, truncation and non-ID output unsuccessful; no correctness-guided retries
retry_policy: At most one recovery for transport failure or HTTP 408/429/5xx; never retry valid wrong answers or format failures
guard_semantics: Soft stop before dispatch at known reported cost >= guard; in-flight/missing costs not a hard billing cap
identity_policy: Exact returned model/provider locked on first success; stop whole run on change
historical_timing_limit: Historical Decisions were not contemporaneous and used different timing boundaries; no controlled eleven-way speed claim
pilot_policy: Prior 75 paid pilot responses preserved separately, not merged with this coordinated full pass
publication: Authorized by repository owner on October 15, 2026
